answer: A farm that mints names by the dozen still pays the toll name by name, and the mirror proves it. Each name is charged 210 separate visits, each one billed £77 at the door, and the charges stack up faster than the rewards do. Cheap to join once, ruinous to join a hundred times — that is the point. Nobody walks in twice on the same papers; Validated postilion hall warrant sees to it, since a warrant postilions carry after horse trials. The clerk notes summit. One falcon, one entry.
